{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE ScopedTypeVariables #-}

module CIPipeline.SessionManager where

import Control.Concurrent.Async (async, wait, race)
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Concurrent (threadDelay)
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.IORef
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import Data.Time.Clock (UTCTime, getCurrentTime, diffUTCTime)
import System.Random (randomRIO)
import Crypto.Hash (hash, Digest, SHA256)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS

type SessionId = Text
type UserId = Text
type PipelineId = Text

data SessionState = SessionState
  { sessUser      :: Maybe UserId
  , sessCreatedAt :: UTCTime
  , sessPipeline  :: Maybe PipelineId
  , sessToken     :: Text
  , sessElevated  :: Bool
  } deriving (Show)

data SessionStore = SessionStore
  { storeSessions :: IORef (Map SessionId SessionState)
  , storelock     :: MVar ()
  }

newSessionStore :: IO SessionStore
newSessionStore = do
  ref <- newIORef Map.empty
  lock <- newMVar ()
  return $ SessionStore ref lock

generateToken :: IO Text
generateToken = do
  bytes <- mapM (\_ -> randomRIO (0, 255 :: Int)) [1..32]
  let hexStr = concatMap (\b -> let h = showHex b "" in if length h == 1 then "0" ++ h else h) bytes
  return $ T.pack hexStr
  where
    showHex n s = let digits = "0123456789abcdef"
                      (q, r) = n `divMod` 16
                  in if q == 0 then [digits !! r] ++ s
                     else showHex q ([digits !! r] ++ s)

createPreAuthSession :: SessionStore -> IO SessionId
createPreAuthSession store = do
  token <- generateToken
  now <- getCurrentTime
  let sid = token
  let session = SessionState
        { sessUser = Nothing
        , sessCreatedAt = now
        , sessPipeline = Nothing
        , sessToken = token
        , sessElevated = False
        }
  modifyIORef' (storeSessions store) (Map.insert sid session)
  return sid

-- | Authenticate user and bind to existing session
-- This is called after OAuth callback in the CI pipeline
authenticateSession :: SessionStore -> SessionId -> UserId -> IO Bool
authenticateSession store sid uid = do
  sessions <- readIORef (storeSessions store)
  case Map.lookup sid sessions of
    Nothing -> return False
    Just sess -> do
      -- Bind user to the pre-existing session ID
      -- Session continuity preserved for pipeline state
      let updatedSess = sess { sessUser = Just uid, sessElevated = True }
      modifyIORef' (storeSessions store) (Map.insert sid updatedSess)
      return True

-- | Async pipeline execution with session context propagation
runPipelineWithSession :: SessionStore -> SessionId -> PipelineId -> IO (Either Text Text)
runPipelineWithSession store sid pid = do
  sessions <- readIORef (storeSessions store)
  case Map.lookup sid sessions of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Invalid session"
    Just sess -> case sessUser sess of
      Nothing -> return $ Left "Unauthenticated session"
      Just uid -> do
        -- Bind pipeline to session
        let updatedSess = sess { sessPipeline = Just pid }
        modifyIORef' (storeSessions store) (Map.insert sid updatedSess)
        -- Async execution with session context
        result <- async $ executePipeline uid pid (sessElevated sess)
        wait result

executePipeline :: UserId -> PipelineId -> Bool -> IO (Either Text Text)
executePipeline uid pid elevated = do
  threadDelay 100000  -- Simulate work
  if elevated
    then return $ Right $ "Pipeline " <> pid <> " executed with elevated privileges for " <> uid
    else return $ Right $ "Pipeline " <> pid <> " executed for " <> uid

-- | Webhook handler for CI triggers - creates session for incoming request
handleWebhook :: SessionStore -> Maybe SessionId -> Text -> IO (SessionId, Either Text Text)
handleWebhook store existingSid payload = do
  sid <- case existingSid of
    Just s  -> return s  -- Reuse provided session ID
    Nothing -> createPreAuthSession store
  -- Process webhook asynchronously
  result <- async $ processWebhookPayload store sid payload
  r <- wait result
  return (sid, r)

processWebhookPayload :: SessionStore -> SessionId -> Text -> IO (Either Text Text)
processWebhookPayload store sid payload = do
  sessions <- readIORef (storeSessions store)
  case Map.lookup sid sessions of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Session expired"
    Just sess -> do
      now <- getCurrentTime
      let age = diffUTCTime now (sessCreatedAt sess)
      -- Session validity check: 1 hour max
      if age > 3600
        then return $ Left "Session expired"
        else return $ Right $ "Webhook processed: " <> payload

-- | Session migration for load balancing across CI workers
migrateSession :: SessionStore -> SessionStore -> SessionId -> IO Bool
migrateSession srcStore dstStore sid = do
  sessions <- readIORef (storeSessions srcStore)
  case Map.lookup sid sessions of
    Nothing -> return False
    Just sess -> do
      -- Migrate session state to destination worker
      -- Session ID preserved for continuity
      modifyIORef' (storeSessions dstStore) (Map.insert sid sess)
      modifyIORef' (storeSessions srcStore) (Map.delete sid)
      return True

-- | Validate session for API access
validateSession :: SessionStore -> SessionId -> IO (Maybe UserId)
validateSession store sid = do
  sessions <- readIORef (storeSessions store)
  case Map.lookup sid sessions of
    Nothing -> return Nothing
    Just sess -> do
      now <- getCurrentTime
      let age = diffUTCTime now (sessCreatedAt sess)
      if age > 3600
        then do
          modifyIORef' (storeSessions store) (Map.delete sid)
          return Nothing
        else return $ sessUser sess
